# Technical Report — Rockburst Agentic AI

**Consolidated final run (Slice 8).** Every headline number below is taken from shipped artefacts (see `artifacts/baselines/headline_snapshot.json`, regenerated by `scripts/generate_figures.py`). Superseded historical values live in [§ History appendix](#history-appendix-m1).

**Delivered system:** deterministic **rules FSM** (M16). Gemini planner is optional/archived; not used for reported metrics.

Figures **F1–F17**: `artifacts/figures/` (≥300 dpi PNG + PDF) with captions in `artifacts/figures/captions.md`.

---

## Lead findings

### (a) Label noise (hypothesis)

Later near-duplicate copies often carry a higher grade (Item 5 / M14). Confirm which label source is authoritative. Sensitivity under label policies: `artifacts/baselines/slice6_m13_m14.json`.

### (b) M1 by protocol (from `m1_results.json`)

| Protocol | QWK | Accuracy | Note |
|----------|-----|----------|------|
| Nested-unbiased OOF | **0.697** | **0.631** | Per-fold inner QWK selection |
| Production pooled OOF (`rf__iterative`) | **0.682** | — | Production = **best mean inner QWK** (M10), not mode-of-winners |
| Selection-biased | 0.719 | — | Optimistic; same outer OOF used to pick model |
| Ablation M1 (quick eval folds) | 0.632 [0.579, 0.684] | 0.590 | `ablation_results.json` |

Fold-winner instability: mode = `lightgbm__median` (2/5); production = `rf__iterative` (mean inner QWK 0.698).

### (c) What agents contribute

| Component | Measured effect (`ablation_results.json`) |
|-----------|-------------------------------------------|
| Grades M5/M6/M7 | **Identical QWK** 0.632 (agents do not change argmax) |
| Abstention | M5 0.087; M6 0.076; **M7 0.517** (Critic escalate active) |
| Critic fire rate | **0.613** |
| Fusion | Locked set **A** (`r_model` only). Risk–coverage: max-prob area **0.668** vs R_final **0.535** (`r_final_beats_max_prob=false`) |
| Conformal | Production **mondrian_split**; coverage ≈ **0.933**, contiguous ordinal sets (M11) |

### (d) Honest statements

- Agents change routes, checks, caution/abstention — **not** grade QWK vs M1.
- R_final ranking does **not** beat max-prob on risk–coverage under set A (C4 negative result retained).
- Mean system confidence can still exceed accuracy; consistency clamp applies when abstain ∧ R_final≈1 (M15).

---

## Dataset

- Table S1, **n = 344**; grades 0–3 (none/light/moderate/strong).
- Features: σθ, σc, σt, SCF, B1, B2, Wet, D; D missing in 131 rows.
- Near-dup grouping at **5%** relative tol on raw measured inputs.

## Training / uncertainty

- Seed 42; nested `StratifiedGroupKFold`; Optuna **n_trials=50** (M9); MLP replaces ExtraTrees; Frank–Hall ordinal variants (M8).
- Production conformal: Mondrian + contiguous sets; per-class coverage in F12.
- Fusion: non-negative logistic on OOF reliability vector; isotonic/Platt calibration; learned decision bands (equations in methodology).

## Ablation (grouped OOF; see F9)

| Model | QWK (mean) | Abstention | Severe-error |
|-------|------------|------------|--------------|
| M1–M3 | 0.632 | 0 | 0.084 |
| M4 | 0.632 | 0.381 | 0.084 |
| M5 | 0.632 | 0.087 | 0.084 |
| M6 | 0.632 | 0.076 | 0.084 |
| M7 | 0.632 | **0.517** | 0.084 |

## Brief §10 constraints

| Constraint | Status | Evidence |
|------------|--------|----------|
| No prompt-only agents | **met** | Deterministic tools only for numbers |
| Do not claim more agents ⇒ better grades | **met** | M5≡M6≡M7 on QWK |
| No test leakage in fit/selection | **met** | Nested CV; fold ensembles; in-memory fold fusion |
| Fusion justified | **met (negative OK)** | Set A locked; R_final ≰ max-prob on RC stated |
| Abstain when inadequate | **met** | Gates + Critic escalate; held-out abstain #77 |
| Not accuracy alone | **met** | QWK, severe, coverage, ECE, RC, Critic rates |

## Limitations

- Small n; duplicate-label authority unresolved.
- Quick evaluate used reduced folds/repeats for some ablation CIs — full `evaluate` regenerates denser CIs.
- SHAP dependence plots optional; F15 uses held-out permutation importance.
- LangGraph pins unused (orchestrator is custom FSM); see methodology § pins (m5).
